description: Mitigation of Seismic Risk to Critical Building Contents via Rolling Pendulum Isolation Systems: Multi-Directional Hybrid Shake Table Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by James Ricles, Lehigh University (lehigh.edu). Participated in a research project that involved multi-directional shake table preparation for future characterization testing of the rolling pendulum floor isolation system to understand its performance. This involved performing kinematics validation of the shake table to develop the actuator control system that will be used in future tests. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7cjc-5n58. Keywords: rolling pendulum floor isolation system, multi-directional shake table, kinematics validation, Fusion 360, ATLSS Engineering Research Center, Lehigh University. Published 2021-08-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
